Rename covers user roots only (src/server/routes/config-rename.ts:171-197). The (rootId, relPath) identity is kept by the per-root walk (markdown-file-store.ts:61-64, 232-246). The code deliberately keeps this pre-window behaviour, and sent deviation dev-0004 (sent: true) records it.
